claims.claim: never buy an item because it's cheap

proof_requests: Photo of the engine identification plate (usually on the side or front).
Photo of the engine bay showing all hoses and belts.
Video of the engine being turned over to confirm it runs.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
